title: Free Guide: Where Your Local Business Should Have Ads Online

facts.fact: The page was published by Hibu on January 2, 2024.
The guide narrows digital advertising to three channels it calls the "big three": Search, Social, and Display Advertising.
facts.quote: To try and simplify it a bit, we'll be focusing on the "big three," Search, Social, and Display Advertising:

facts.fact: Search advertising ads appear when customers are searching for a product or service, usually on Google, Bing, or Yahoo.
facts.quote: The ads that appear when customers are Searching for a product or service, usually on Google, Bing, or Yahoo

facts.fact: Social advertising ads appear when customers are socializing on networks such as Facebook and Instagram.
facts.quote: The ads that appear when customers are Socializing on their favorite networks, like Facebook and Instagram

facts.fact: Display advertising ads appear when customers are browsing their most-visited websites.
facts.quote: The ads that appear when customers are Surfing on their most-visited websites

facts.fact: In search advertising, advertisers bid on keywords, and the search engine analyzes the bids to determine which ads "win" and can be shown at the top of results.
facts.quote: search ads allow advertisers to bid on keywords relevant to their product or service.

facts.fact: Search ads are usually very simple in design, typically consisting of just a set amount of text.
facts.quote: usually just a set amount of text

facts.fact: The guide states that Google Ads is, by many measures, the most popular paid search platform, followed by Bing Ads, which also serves a significant portion of Yahoo ads.
facts.quote: By many measures, the most popular paid search platform used today is Google Ads, followed by Bing Ads, which also serves a significant portion of ads on Yahoo.

facts.fact: Search ad extensions named on the page include Location Extensions, Sitelink Extensions, Call Extensions, and Structured Snippets.
facts.quote: like Location Extensions, Sitelink Extensions, Call Extensions, and Structured Snippets

facts.fact: The guide defines conversion rate for search ads as the rate at which people take action on a site by calling, emailing, or messaging the business.
facts.quote: the rate at which people take action on your site by calling, emailing, or messaging you
